subject: CHANGES REQUESTED S16 rework @fdfd148 (re-review): D1-D12, D14 + lazy-load verified fixed; new Medium: rebalance swaps question order (D10 fix regression); D13 pill still clipped
body:
Re-review of the S16 rework (fdfd148, tested on tip 53564a9, which contains it). Done msg 20261117T074726-seg16-planner-008075. Prior review: 20261117T063353-review16-6b3df1.
Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED, narrow: 1 new Medium regression in rebalance plus D13 only partly fixed. D1–D12 and D14 are fixed and verified, and so is the lazy-load follow-up. CI run 44041379633 (fdfd148) is still QUEUED, so the full matrix is not judged; any approval stays conditional on it being green.

WHAT I RAN (local *-review16 containers only; ambient APP_BASE_URL unset; the Space was not touched)
- pnpm install --frozen-lockfile OK; lint OK; typecheck OK; vitest 953 (ui 33, shared 133, ink 75, web 712) PASS; pytest not-live/not-db 1680 PASS; gen:contracts + gen:requirements: no drift.
- alembic: single head (0034 on tip); 0034->0031 downgrade and back up clean. information_schema: authenticated has no UPDATE on plan_items.
- db (fresh stack): tests/plan + test_rls + test_migrate + test_planner_graph: 198 PASS. Full -m db: 633 pass, 6 F / 17 E, none from S16: embedder not cached here (no HF), Storage leftovers in the migrations round-trip, seed counts, S21 authoring, the S15 ingest benchmark, and test_only_the_qbank_and_the_seed_read_answer_columns, which now flags S15's ingest/placements/builtin.py (lead: route that to seg15).
- e2e smoke set (planner+today+shell, --retries=0 --workers=2, webkit-ipad-portrait/landscape/phone-390 + chromium-laptop-1440), 2x: planner.spec 0 failures in both runs on all 4 projects, including the Chromium push SW test (notification + click deep link). The 12 failures per run are all today/shell: no seeded questions in my DB (e2e_today history, diagnostic waitForURL); the S14 assistant offline banner making getByRole('status', 'Offline') match 2 elements; an inline-stylesheet CSP line on that same offline test. None trace to S16.
- Screenshots test-results/screens/16 re-checked.

ITEM BY ITEM
D1 FIXED. Server logs from the e2e run: 48 ICS lines (24 naadi.request, 24 app.access_logs), all "/api/plan/ics/[redacted]"; 0 tokens.
D2 FIXED. Prod build under require-trusted-types-for 'script': 0 TT console lines in WebKit and Chromium, with the SW allowed or blocked; with TT ENFORCED the SW still registers in both browsers and the console stays empty.
D3 FIXED. The push SW test passed 2/2 on Chromium (full Chromium + notifications grant; it also checks the click deep link). CI installs full chromium, and the browser is closed in finally.
D4 FIXED. push/hosts.py allowlist (no IP literals or odd ports, https only), checked both at subscribe and at send; endpoint takeover now gives 409 unless it is the same user or the same keys.
D5 FIXED. 0032 revokes UPDATE; Today's status route now writes as the service with the user in the statement.
D6 FIXED. Stamp clamped with least(stamp, server_ms + 5 min).
D7 FIXED. The drop loop places without spill; spill only in the final pass. My earlier probe now drops the review instead of spilling.
D8 FIXED. A partial send records last_sent_on/sent_today; transient failures no longer delete.
D9 FIXED. apply() marks the proposal stale when any to_day < the student's local today.
D10 FIXED, BUT THE FIX INTRODUCES R1 (below).
D11 FIXED. APP_BASE_URL "" pinned in the webServer env; the spec asserts the feed URL's origin equals baseURL.
D12 FIXED. Uses request.client.host only.
D13 PARTLY FIXED. "Day off" now shows for a non-study day inside the plan (Thu 19). The "Outside Naadi" pill is STILL clipped (R2).
D14 FIXED. origin='user' items appear in the ICS as a generic ui_copy label.
Lazy-load FIXED. In dist, the entry (main-*.js) and its modulepreloads contain no LangGraph SDK; the SDK (client-*.js) and PlannerPage-*.js are separate lazy chunks. FYI for S22, not S16: the entry plus preloads is still ~388 KB gz against the 250 KB budget.

NEW / REMAINING
R1. MEDIUM, rebalance swaps the order of moved question items (regression from the D10 fix). rebalance.py _Placement.run: a non-spilling item restarts its search at (0, 0) once the cursor is past window 0, ignoring where earlier window-0 items were placed. Repro (pure fn, scratch probe): days D1..D6, assessment D4, exam D7, today D2 (k1 read 30m planned; cap 75), missed on D1 in order: q1 questions 60m, m1 read 60m, q2 questions 30m. Result: q1 -> D3 sort 0, m1 -> D5 (spilled), q2 -> D2 sort 1. q2 now lands before q1, which breaks "moved items keep their order" (the module docstring and the brief). The property test asserts order but its generated plans never produce this; add this as a golden case. Fix: keep a separate window-0 cursor (w0_k) that non-spilling items resume from, instead of (0, 0).
R2. LOW, the "Outside Naadi" pill still overflows the assessment card and is clipped at iPad landscape (planner-suggestion--webkit-ipad-landscape.png, Sat 14, crop: "Outside Naadi" cut off at the card's right border). ItemBlock.tsx: max-w-full/whitespace-normal on the Chip has no visible effect; the Chip's own classes (nowrap/shrink-0/letter-spacing) probably win. Check the rendered classes and make the chip wrap or truncate with a title, then re-shoot portrait/landscape.

After R1 (with the golden test) and R2: approve, conditional on a green CI run that contains the fix (webkit + Chromium, including the push SW test).
